# Native configuration (iOS and Android)

Values are from Color Match & Merge. Lines marked *per app* change in each game.

## iOS

### `ios/App/App/Info.plist` (add inside the top-level `<dict>`)

```xml
<!-- Export compliance: stops the encryption question on every upload. Commit it;
     it went missing once because Info.plist was left uncommitted. -->
<key>ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption</key>
<false/>

<!-- iOS 14.5+: required before ATT can be requested (per app wording). -->
<key>NSUserTrackingUsageDescription</key>
<string>This lets us show ads matched to your interests instead of generic ones. We do not collect your name, email, contacts, photos or location, and your puzzle progress never leaves your device. Decline and the game plays exactly the same, with generic ads.</string>

<!-- Unity Ads SKAdNetwork ID. Add Unity's partner IDs if mediation is enabled. -->
<key>SKAdNetworkItems</key>
<array>
  <dict>
    <key>SKAdNetworkIdentifier</key>
    <string>4dzt52r2t5.skadnetwork</string>
  </dict>
</array>

<!-- Firebase off until consent. _ENABLED, never _DEACTIVATED (permanent). -->
<key>FIREBASE_ANALYTICS_COLLECTION_ENABLED</key><false/>
<key>GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_ANALYTICS_STORAGE</key><false/>
<key>GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_AD_STORAGE</key><false/>
<key>GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_AD_USER_DATA</key><false/>
<key>GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT_ALLOW_AD_PERSONALIZATION_SIGNALS</key><false/>
```

If the app used AdMob before, remove `GADApplicationIdentifier`, `GADIsAdManagerApp` and Google's SKAdNetwork ID.

### Project

- **`GoogleService-Info.plist`** (*per app*) goes in `ios/App/App/` and must be **registered in `App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`**. That means a `PBXFileReference`, a `PBXBuildFile`, membership in the App group and an entry in `PBXResourcesBuildPhase`. `grep -c GoogleService-Info.plist project.pbxproj` should print `4`.
- **`AppDelegate.swift`:** no Firebase import and no `FirebaseApp.configure()`.
- **Deployment target:** iOS 15.0, which the Unity package requires.
- **`ios/App/CapApp-SPM/Package.swift`** is generated by `cap sync`; don't edit it. After sync it should list `CapacitorFirebaseAnalytics`, `CapacitorLocalNotifications`, `CapgoNativePurchases` and `PolitecarrotCapacitorUnityAds`.
- **No entitlements file is needed.** Local notifications need no Push capability, and In-App Purchase is enabled by default on explicit App IDs.
- **Versions** are set in `project.pbxproj` for both the Debug and Release configurations:
  - `MARKETING_VERSION`: the version shown in the store, for example 1.2.1.
  - `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`: the build number. It must increase with every upload of the same version.

## Android

### `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`

`<manifest>` needs `xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"`.

Inside `<application>`:

```xml
<!-- Firebase off until consent. _enabled, never _deactivated (permanent). -->
<meta-data android:name="firebase_analytics_collection_enabled" android:value="false"/>
<meta-data android:name="google_analytics_default_allow_analytics_storage" android:value="false"/>
<meta-data android:name="google_analytics_default_allow_ad_storage" android:value="false"/>
<meta-data android:name="google_analytics_default_allow_ad_user_data" android:value="false"/>
<meta-data android:name="google_analytics_default_allow_ad_personalization_signals" android:value="false"/>
```

After `</application>`:

```xml
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
<!-- targetSdk 33+: needed for Unity Ads to read the Advertising ID. -->
<uses-permission android:name="com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID" />
<!-- Reminders are inexact; drop the plugin's exact-alarm permission (Play policy). -->
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM" tools:node="remove" />
```

If the app used AdMob before, remove the `com.google.android.gms.ads.APPLICATION_ID` meta-data.

After a build, check `android/app/build/intermediates/merged_manifests/*/process*Manifest/AndroidManifest.xml`. It should contain these permissions and **no** `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`:

- `INTERNET`
- `AD_ID`
- `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`
- `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`
- `WAKE_LOCK`
- `com.android.vending.BILLING`
- `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID`, `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION` and `ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOPICS`, which come from the SDKs

### `android/app/build.gradle`

```groovy
apply plugin: 'com.android.application'
apply plugin: 'com.google.gms.google-services'
// defaultConfig: versionCode must exceed the last Play upload; versionName is the display version.
dependencies {
    // 33.7.0 rather than 34.x: its analytics artifact is on the Aliyun mirror.
    implementation platform('com.google.firebase:firebase-bom:33.7.0')
    implementation 'com.google.firebase:firebase-analytics'
    // …Capacitor defaults…
}
```

Put `google-services.json` (*per app*) in `android/app/`. `cap sync` adds the plugin modules in `capacitor.build.gradle`; never add them by hand.

### `android/build.gradle` (root)

```groovy
buildscript {
    repositories {
        // Aliyun first: dl.google.com drops mid-transfer on some networks. google() stays as the fallback.
        maven { url 'https://maven.aliyun.com/repository/google' }
        maven { url 'https://maven.aliyun.com/repository/public' }
        google()
        mavenCentral()
    }
    dependencies {
        classpath 'com.android.tools.build:gradle:9.3.2'
        classpath 'com.google.gms:google-services:4.4.4'
    }
}
allprojects { repositories { /* same four, same order */ } }
// Optional: pin every module to installed Build-Tools (cap sync regenerates per-module files).
subprojects { afterEvaluate { proj -> if (proj.hasProperty('android')) proj.android.buildToolsVersion = "36.1.0" } }
```

`variables.gradle`: `minSdkVersion = 24`, `compileSdkVersion = 36`, `targetSdkVersion = 36`.

### Java (`android/app/src/main/java/<package path>/`)

- **[NotificationSettingsPlugin.java](../assets/android/NotificationSettingsPlugin.java):** `@CapacitorPlugin(name = "NotificationSettings")` with one method, `open()`. Change the `package` line.
- **[MainActivity.java](../assets/android/MainActivity.java):** the only required line is `registerPlugin(NotificationSettingsPlugin.class);` **before** `super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)`. The rest of the file is optional polish:
  - `setTextZoom(80)`: the WebView ignores the system font scale, which keeps px-based layouts intact.
  - No long-press text selection (Samsung One UI ignores CSS `user-select`).
  - No floating action mode.
  - System-bar padding on **API 35+ only**. Android 15 forces edge-to-edge; on 14 and below the same padding would double up and leave a black strip.
- **[ic_stat_daily.xml](../assets/android/ic_stat_daily.xml)** goes in `res/drawable/`. It's a white vector silhouette; replace the paths with the game's own shape.

### Versions

`versionCode` must exceed every earlier Play upload, drafts included. `versionName` is free text, and the iOS and Android display versions can differ.

## Capacitor config and sync

- **[capacitor.config.js](../assets/build/capacitor.config.js)** runs `sync-web.js` as a side effect whenever any `cap` command loads it, so `npx cap sync` alone always rebuilds `www/` first.
- **[sync-web.js](../assets/build/sync-web.js)** calls [sync-dependencies.js](../assets/build/sync-dependencies.js) to copy the vendor file. It then copies `index.html`, the listed static assets, and everything referenced by `<script src>` or stylesheet `<link>` tags into a clean `www/`.
- **After sync,** the copies in `www/`, `ios/App/App/public/` and `android/app/src/main/assets/public/` are byte-identical to the sources. A quick check: `cmp js/ads.js ios/App/App/public/js/ads.js`.
